g.title: blackbox
g.text: → conditioning with single representation s [B, tokens, d_s]

g.title: inject
g.text: s′ = k·s + b (identical shape / dtype / device)

g.title: reuse
g.text: cached once, reused across all 200 steps
→ a CONSTANT bias that compounds over the trajectory

g.title: shapes
g.text: (s is [B,tokens,d], not coords → no shape change)

g.title: nan
g.text: OOD s′ (large k or b) → unstable x̂₀ / NaN
GUARD: clamp |Δ|, assert_no_nans on step output

g.title: leak
g.text: → autograd leak (Boltz step does NOT detach)

g.title: reward
g.text: reward on COORDS, grad on coords only

g.title: legend
g.text: gray INVARIANT — provably safe (no s dependence)
orange INDIRECT — shifted inputs, same mechanism
